title: Paid-Claims Offset on Removal of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons Rider: Regional Claims Terms
content:
**Contract terms extract.** When an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider is removed, the removal benefit-offset share, the share of the rider benefit authorized in the current term (net of reversals) taken off the removal credit, follows the claims terms in Bridgewell's filed contract terms for the region where the base homeowner property lies, read from the property ZIP code recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract.

| Property ZIP code | Filed claims terms for the region | Removal benefit-offset share |
|---|---|---|
| 43000 through 45999 (Ohio) | Deduct no paid claims from a refund of unearned premium | Zero |
| 10000 through 14999 (New York) | Deduct no paid claims from a refund of unearned premium | Zero |
| 73000 through 74999 (Oklahoma) | Deduct half of the paid claims | 0.5 (one half) |
| Any other ZIP code | | One |

The offset is the rider benefit authorized in the current term, net of reversals, multiplied by this share and rounded to the cent.

**Hypothetical cases (USD 300.00 of rider benefit authorized in the term, net).**

| Property ZIP code | Offset |
|---|---|
| 12207 (New York) | USD 0.00 |
| 74103 (Oklahoma) | USD 150.00 |
| 75201 | USD 300.00 |
